title: Team Lab and Wrap-up
html:
What this group does: the six phases ran on the customer-service scenario we handed you. This group puts the same flywheel around your own business case, then clears the resources out of the lab account.

Chapter Contents Main accounts
Team Lab: Put Your Own Agent on the Flywheel Keep the teams from Teams and Roles, swap in your own scenario, run one turn of the flywheel, then demo and score Everyone
Wrap-up and Cleanup Delete experiments, online evaluation, agents, knowledge bases, registry records and accounts in dependency order admin, developer

Finish the console cleanup of the cleanup chapter before the event ends, and tell the organiser. The environment itself (EC2, CloudFront, the shared infrastructure) is torn down by the organiser after the event, see the Organizer deployment guide; until then, the AgentCore runtimes, the knowledge base and CloudFront keep billing in the organiser's account.
